name: Ashlo
role: Runner for the Lord-Marshal's quartermaster; the agitator who threw the first torch at Okton's forge. Held in Halda's inner cells.
appearance: Wiry and quick, with a runner's lean legs and a camp-follower's patched coat; a fading grin that dies when he is looked at.
voice: Fast, nervous patter. Tells the truth in a rush when frightened, then insists he only did as he was told.
backstory: Ashlo ran messages and errands for the Ash Companies' quartermaster, Unara. On day 9 she told him to make a spark at Okton's forge so the Marshal's dawn search would have cause, and he also took half-pay in silver from a grey-shawled woman of the Choir to carry the first torch. Chadickith caught and questioned him at the forge, and walked him to Halda's Collarhouse, where a hidden crossbowman on a Steamside roof tried to silence him on the way and missed. He now sits in the inner cells under a doubled guard, with Rook's orderly Fenia for company, and has said that Lorard himself knew nothing.
wants: To keep from hanging, and to be sent back to the company in one piece.
fears: The rooftop crossbowman finishing the job; the Ash Companies voting on him as they will on Unara; Chadickith.

relationships.how: the quartermaster who sent him to make the spark
the Marshal, whom he has never spoken to; he swears the Marshal knew nothing
the quartermaster's deputy, who hands out the day's errands
the Watch-Captain who holds him and believed his account
Rook's orderly, held in the next cell
the loxodon who bound and questioned him, then walked him to the Collarhouse

secrets: He believes the spark was Unara's idea, not the Marshal's: she told him to say it was for the quartermaster if he was caught.
He can describe the grey-shawled woman who paid him in flame-stamped silver, though he does not know her name.
dm_only: Who sent the rooftop crossbowman is not settled in canon (the Choir is the obvious answer). Halda holds his silver.
Invented by npc-creator: his age and looks, the voice, that he can describe the grey woman, and the Commoner stat block.
